completion_data.completion_summary: Fixed the locale-dependent false identifier-mismatch defect in lean-challenge-snapshot.sh by pinning LC_ALL=C on the goals-side sort and both comm comparison calls, added a mixed-case RED/GREEN regression case (R5) with a verified mutation kill, audited all cross-tool sort/compare sites, and redeployed the fix into the ~/Projects/BimodalLogic consuming repo (verified byte-identical, 14/14 suite passing there).

memory_candidates.content: When comparing two identifier lists across tools with `comm`, both inputs must be sorted under the SAME collation. A shell `sort -u` running under an ambient dictionary-collation locale (e.g. en_US.UTF-8) orders mixed-case identifiers differently than a Python `sorted()` (code-point order), so a mixed and unpinned pairing produces spurious `comm` mismatches (or, worse, silently misses real ones when both sides happen to mis-sort into apparent agreement). Fix: pin `LC_ALL=C` inline, scoped to just the sort/comm pipeline (never exported process-wide), on whichever side doesn't already use code-point order, and pin `comm` itself too as defense-in-depth. A regression fixture needs mixed-case names that provably reorder between dictionary and code-point collation (e.g. hnOpenMirror/hnStabMirror/hn_stab) to actually exercise the bug.

When adding a new test fixture file to an agent-system extension, remember to also add it to that extension's manifest.json file list -- fixtures under scripts/tests/fixtures/** are declared individually by filename, not deployed via a directory glob. A fixture missing from the manifest deploys the fixed script and test suite but silently omits the fixture itself, so a deployed-suite run can fail even though the source-store suite passes. Diff the deployed fixtures directory against the source store during redeploy verification to catch this.
